messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a public holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, creating a three‑day break that includes the adjacent weekend.)

| Holiday | Observed Date (2023) | Notes |
|---------|----------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | **Monday, Jan 2** (observed; Jan 1 was a Sunday) | Creates a long weekend Jan 1–3 |
| **Canada Day** | **Monday, Jul 3** (observed; Jul 1 was a Saturday) | Long weekend Jul 1–3 |
| **Labour Day** | **Monday, Sep 4** | Long weekend Sep 2–4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | **Monday, Oct 9** | Long weekend Oct 7–9 |
| **Christmas** | **Monday, Dec 25** | Long weekend Dec 23–25 |

> **Tip:** If you’re planning trips for specific provinces, you’ll want to add their own statutory holidays (e.g., Family Day in Alberta on Feb 20, Victoria Day in Ontario on May 22, etc.). Those can also create additional long weekends.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown (including provincial holidays).
